card.name: Capital B starting drug names
card.fires_on: The capital letter B that begins a new word after a space or period, especially the start of brand or drug names like Bortezomib, BESPONSA and Bacteriostatic. Also the digit 1 before a thousand or billion figure.

modes.label: B opening a name
modes.description: A split-off capital B starting a drug or product name, or a sentence-initial word.

modes.label: Digit 1 in big numbers
modes.description: The digit 1 right before a thousand or billion figure.
modes.example: Rate (MMR) to 2 per <<1>>000 live births by 2

card.writes: It pushes toward continuations like M, billions and mn, which fit number-scale and B-word completions.
card.plain: It lights up on a capital B that starts a drug name such as Bortezomib, and on a 1 that begins a large number.
